name: io.github.Shicodiez/crypto-regime-mcp
title: Crypto Regime MCP
description: Crypto trend and regime MCP tools with automatic x402 payments or prepaid credits.

environmentVariables.name: SIGNAL_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Prepaid credit key (sk_...) returned by POST /credits/buy/starter or /credits/buy/pro. When set, paid tools call /v1/* with X-API-Key and no x402 signing is used.

environmentVariables.name: EVM_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: EVM private key used to sign x402 payments when SIGNAL_API_KEY is not set. Use a dedicated low-balance wallet.

environmentVariables.name: MAX_SPEND_USDC
environmentVariables.description: Maximum USDC the bridge may spend per session in x402 mode. Defaults to 1.

environmentVariables.name: SIGNAL_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: REST base URL used in credit mode. Defaults to the origin of the MCP URL.
